assumptions.clv: Closing line = YES-equivalent price of the last print strictly before Gamma closedTime (or the last print when closedTime is missing). CLV ROI is (signed*(close - entry)*qty - fee)/stake.
assumptions.copy_price: First executed print on the same market at or after signal_time + lag, plus slippage_ticks against us. A print is evidence liquidity existed; it is not a resting quote.
assumptions.copy_size: stake_per_copy / price, whole contracts, capped by the reference print's size (no depth on the tape). Risk rails: $25/order, 100 contracts/market, $75 daily loss.
assumptions.farmer_filter: two_sided_share = markets where the wallet ended up long both outcomes / markets traded; above max_two_sided_share the wallet's prints are refused two_sided_flow.
assumptions.fees: Polymarket taker fee C*rate*p*(1-p) with rate from Gamma feeType (sports 5%); makers pay nothing; rebates ignored.
assumptions.fixture: Network tape harvested from public endpoints at harvested_at; see universe.
assumptions.kalshi: Not identifiable: public /markets/trades carries no account identity. Whether tennis series are listed is recorded but changes nothing.
assumptions.settlement: Resolved markets (umaResolutionStatus=resolved, outcomePrices 1/0) settle in the ledger at 1/0; open positions marked at the last print's YES-equivalent price and counted as unrealized.
assumptions.whale_definition: Walk-forward: min_large_fills taker prints >= large_fill_notional USDC across >= min_markets tennis markets, all strictly before the print being evaluated.

fail_risks: exit_liquidity: a copy fills at a print, not a resting book; the tape shows no depth, so real fills at size may be worse than the print+slippage assumption and exits before settlement are not modelled.
farmers_and_makers: volume farmers, hedgers and market makers take both sides; the two_sided_share filter removes the obvious ones only, and a whale can be a farmer on other sports we do not see.
selection_on_notional: whales are chosen by taker size, not skill; large takers can be informed, or simply rich and wrong. The whale-own benchmark shows whether the signal itself had edge.
wallet_fragmentation: one actor may use several proxy wallets, so repeat-size detection undercounts (false negatives) and clustering by market is the only dependence structure modelled.
resolved_universe_bias: resolved markets are listed by close time; short in-play markets dominate and long-dated tournament futures are underrepresented.
tape_truncation: per-market trade caps keep the newest prints (endgame flow) when a market is truncated; markets_truncated is reported.
fee_model: venue taker fee C*rate*p*(1-p) by Gamma feeType; rebates and maker programmes are not modelled.
multiple_lags: three lags are three tests; CIs are Bonferroni-corrected but the PASS-at-any-lag rule is still a disjunction.

pre_registration.hypothesis: Wallets that repeatedly take size on Polymarket tennis carry information; copying their next print at a lag earns positive settlement EV or CLV after fees.
pre_registration.kill_rule: Kill when (a) every lag has sufficient data and both settlement ROI and CLV ROI have CI upper bound < 0, or (b) the whale-own benchmark (the whales' own fills at lag 0, taker fee) has settlement-ROI CI upper bound < 0 with sufficient data. Either trigger ends the track; there is no re-tuning of thresholds after seeing results.
pre_registration.pass_rule: At one or more lags in [30, 120, 600] s, the market-clustered bootstrap CI lower bound of equal-weighted per-copy ROI is > 0 for settlement ROI or CLV ROI after fees and slippage.
